name: gate-g1
note: A gate row of renderer/shell/gate_d02.py: the steps before the repeat block set the views; the block runs for warm-up plus window seconds as quiet steps (d02_run.expand_repeat), and tools/perf/d02/gate_row.py times the last window seconds. No step follows the block, so the window holds only the row's views. B19 G1, the one-view baseline: Global with the contact-class tint, twist sweeps repeating, Local hidden. The keymap's Local row (view.local, L in Global) has no handler in the shell yet: while Local draws the default or named cap the window shows two panes and gate_d02 reports the run as invalid for G1 (one pane). Cap 2 is named because its twelve menu items are admissible at deep-2 and wj-ia-end (the samples' cap-2 release checks); K, the router's item 2, commits and sweeps over jumble.sweep's time, and repeats cycle through the twist's powers. A refused press sweeps nothing, which gate_d02 reports as an invalid run.
